The '''Gurrisalia system''' was located in the [[Relgim sector/Legends|Relgim sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Sacred Scroll of Gurrisalia]] originated from the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="RC:TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Sacred Scroll of Gurrisalia]]|system=Gurrisalia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Gurrisalia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-5.<ref name="TEA" />
